title: 第19章 瞬间击杀第20章 二转碧灵桃树的价值
content_zh:
李衍道点了点头，随即掐动法诀。
霎时间，房间内的墙壁上泛起了淡淡的光芒，无数符文在空中流转，形成一层看不见的结界。
见李衍道布下的禁制已然完成，老者缓缓开口说道：
“正如公子所料，我们手中的这株灵桃树确实是二转碧灵桃。
之所以对外宣称是普通的水灵桃树，是因为担心引来不必要的窥视与争抢。”
李衍道听罢，眸中闪过一丝惊喜，但他依旧保持着冷静，故意透露出一丝自己炼气后期的气息，确认道：“果真如此？”
老者见状，深吸了一口气，继续说道：“的确如此。
那三株灵桃树位于海外的一座荒岛之上，起初有一只妖兽守护，后来被我和孙女联手将其斩杀，自此那片岛屿便成了我们的修行之地。”
“这次我们冒险外出，意图出售其中一株灵桃树，主要是为了换取一些丹药和其他修行资源，以加速孙女的修行。”
老者说话间，目光温柔地望向周鸿瑜，显然，这位孙女是他最大的牵挂。
李衍道听后，点了点头，似乎对老者二人的奇遇并不感到意外。
他接着问道：“那么，你们现在有什么打算？”
老者不禁苦笑，长叹一声后说道：“凭我们目前的实力，恐怕很难逃离青元坊市。
恩公您对我们有再造之恩，因此我希望能将二转碧灵桃树，以及远在海外的另外两棵一并赠予公子。”
李衍道微微颔首，语气中带着一丝关切，直截了当地询问道：“那你们有什么特别的需求吗？”
老者沉思片刻，目光转向身旁的女子，缓缓开口道：
“我的寿元已近极限，气血逐渐衰弱，此生怕是再也无法突破练气后期的桎梏。
而今，我唯一的挂念就是我的孙女。”
听罢此言，李衍道心中已然明了老者的忧虑所在，他转头望向那位名叫周鸿瑜的女子，语气坚定地说：
“她可以加入我李家，成为李家的一员。

我可以保证，今后定会善待她，并且会将她视为李家的精英后辈来悉心栽培。”
老者听闻李衍道的提议，心中不禁一喜，然而眉头却依旧紧锁，他坦诚地说道：
“我希望将她许配给公子，不知道公子意下如何？”
李衍道闻言一怔，心中不由自主地泛起了波澜。
自穿越至此世界以来，他还未曾认真思考过道侣之事。
周鸿瑜的美貌无疑令人动容，有着倾国倾城之姿，然而他当前最为关切的仍是修行之路与家族的安危。
至于儿女情长，那必然是要等到一切尘埃落定之后方才考虑的事情。
老者的考量并非无理，周鸿瑜若仅是加入李家，终归是个外姓之人。
唯有通过结为道侣的方式，才能真正融入家族之中。
而李衍道刚刚展现出炼气后期的修为，在这样的年纪便拥有如此实力，无疑是老者心目中最理想的候选人。
经过一番深思熟虑，李衍道最终回应道：“我目前尚无意迎娶道侣，待李家根基稳固之后，再作考虑也不迟。”
李家目前连最基本的岛屿防护阵法都尚未布置，倘若遭遇多家修士联手进攻，根本无力抵御。
因此，在他开辟出灵田之后，最紧迫的任务便是为风林岛购置一套至少一阶上品的防御阵法。
阵法与法器一般无二，造价不菲，一套一阶上品的阵法价值大约在八九百枚灵石之间。
老者听闻李衍道的解释后微微一愣。
周鸿瑜虽拥有的是中品木灵根，但其资质已接近上品，若只是单纯加入李家而无正式身份，难免会在家族内部遭受排挤。
见老者仍旧面露疑虑，李衍道进一步给出了一个既不完全拒绝也非立即接受的答案：
“待我筑基成功后，自会考虑延续血脉之事。当前最重要的是壮大李家。
至于鸿瑜，若将来时机成熟，缘分使然，自然可结为道侣。
若无缘，我亦会视她如妹妹般爱护。”

凡事皆需循序渐进，情感的培育更是如此。
只有通过时间的沉淀与相处，才能真正了解彼此，进而产生深厚的情感。
content_en:
Li Yandao nodded, and then used the magic formula.
In an instant, a faint light glowed on the walls of the room, and countless runes circulated in the air, forming an invisible barrier.
Seeing that the restriction imposed by Li Yandao had been completed, the old man slowly spoke:
"As the young master expected, the spiritual peach tree in our hands is indeed a second-level green peach tree.
The reason why it is claimed to be an ordinary peach tree is because it is worried about attracting unnecessary prying eyes and competition. "
After Li Yandao heard this, a hint of surprise flashed in his eyes, but he still remained calm, deliberately revealing a hint of his late-stage Qi refining aura, and confirmed: "Is this really so?"
Seeing this, the old man took a deep breath and continued: "That's true.
The three spiritual peach trees were located on a deserted island overseas. They were guarded by a monster at first, but later my granddaughter and I teamed up to kill it. Since then, that island has become our place of practice. "
"This time we ventured out with the intention of selling one of the spiritual peach trees, mainly in exchange for some elixirs and other cultivation resources to speed up my granddaughter's cultivation."
As the old man spoke, he looked at Zhou Hongyu tenderly. Obviously, this granddaughter was his biggest concern.
After hearing this, Li Yandao nodded, as if he was not surprised by the adventure of the two old men.
He then asked: "So, what are your plans now?"
The old man couldn't help but smile bitterly, sighed and said: "With our current strength, I'm afraid it will be difficult to escape Qingyuanfang City.
My benefactor, you have been kind to us, so I hope to give the second-turn Biling peach tree and the other two trees far away overseas to the young master. "
Li Yandao nodded slightly, with a hint of concern in his tone, and asked directly: "Do you have any special needs?"
The old man pondered for a moment, turned his eyes to the woman beside him, and slowly said:
"My lifespan is approaching its limit, and my energy and blood are gradually weakening. I am afraid that I will never be able to break through the shackles of the late stages of Qi training in this life.
Now, my only concern is my granddaughter. "
After hearing this, Li Yandao already understood the old man's worries. He turned to look at the woman named Zhou Hongyu and said firmly:
“She can join my Li family and become a member of the Li family.
I can guarantee that I will treat her well in the future and will cultivate her carefully as an elite descendant of the Li family. "
When the old man heard Li Yandao's proposal, he couldn't help but feel happy, but his brows were still furrowed. He said frankly:
"I hope to betroth her to the young master. I wonder what the young master wants?"
Li Yandao was startled when he heard the words, and his heart was involuntarily filled with waves.
Since traveling to this world, he has never seriously thought about Taoist companions.
Zhou Hongyu's beauty is undoubtedly moving, and he has the appearance of charming a country. However, what he is most concerned about at the moment is his spiritual path and the safety of his family.
As for the love between children, that must be something that can only be considered after everything has settled.
The old man's consideration is not unreasonable. If Zhou Hongyu only joins the Li family, he will be a person with a foreign surname after all.
Only by becoming a Taoist couple can one truly integrate into the family.
And Li Yandao had just shown his cultivation in the late stage of Qi refining, and with such strength at such an age, he was undoubtedly the most ideal candidate in the old man's mind.
After some careful consideration, Li Yandao finally responded: "I have no intention of marrying a Taoist couple at the moment. It will not be too late to consider it after the Li family has a solid foundation."
The Li family has not yet deployed even the most basic island protection formation. If multiple monks join forces to attack, they will be unable to resist.
Therefore, after he opened up the spiritual field, the most urgent task was to purchase a set of at least first-level high-quality defensive formations for Fenglin Island.
Formations are generally the same as magic weapons and are expensive to make. A set of first-level high-grade formations is worth about eight to nine hundred spirit stones.
The old man was slightly startled after hearing Li Yandao's explanation..
Although Zhou Hongyu possesses mid-grade wood spirit roots, his qualifications are close to top-grade. If he simply joins the Li family without a formal status, he will inevitably be ostracized within the family.
Seeing that the old man still had doubts on his face, Li Yandao further gave an answer that was neither completely rejected nor immediately accepted:
"After I successfully build the foundation, I will consider continuing the bloodline. The most important thing at the moment is to strengthen the Li family.
As for Hongyu, if the time is right in the future and fate dictates, we can naturally become a Taoist couple.
If not, I will treat her like a sister and love her. "
Everything needs to be done step by step, especially the cultivation of emotions.
Only through the accumulation of time and getting along with each other can we truly understand each other and develop deep emotions.
